name: Achillea

project_scope.admission_note: A. millefolium approved for learner; Texas native-range CONFLICT; exclude from native metrics.

shared_genus_characters.look_here_first: Inspect finely divided leaves and a single capitulum; compare ray count, phyllary rows and the flat-topped arrangement of many small heads.
shared_genus_characters.shared: Aromatic herbs with many small heads in clustered inflorescences; leaf dissection and capitulum architecture are primary learner cues.

local_lookalike_cautions: Anthemis cotula has solitary larger heads; inspect cluster architecture.
Tanacetum parthenium has broader lobed foliage and larger heads.
Artemisia ludoviciana has less finely divided foliage and inconspicuous heads.
diagnostic_photo_checklist: head front and phyllary side view
